summary: Confirmed that EAGLE creates DSA draft-decode children and a draft-extend backend after ModelRunner's generic KVIndexTranslator binding pass. On the recorded base, both forms retained AttentionBackend.kv_index_translator=None. DeepseekSparseAttnBackend now copies the owning runner's translator during construction, covering the FP8 ROCm MHA prefix-read dereference and static-pool passthrough behavior.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-828b4d5abce5/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/amd/test_eagle_dsa_kv_index_translator.py (with the binding line temporarily removed to reproduce the recorded base)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on one gfx950: the late-created draft-extend backend and both multi-step draft-decode children had kv_index_translator=None. Raw output: reports/j-828b4d5abce5/evidence/regression-before.log

Passing-after regression on one gfx950: the late-created draft-extend backend and two multi-step draft-decode children share the runner's exact translator; static-pool read translation preserves non-empty prefix ids. 2 tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-828b4d5abce5/evidence/regression-after.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The focused regression allocated the repository's real FP8 DSATokenToKVPool and CUDA tensors on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950). Environment capture: reports/j-828b4d5abce5/evidence/gpu-environment.log

remaining_limitations: The reported four-GPU TP/EP GLM-5.3 EAGLE server workload was not run because only one GPU was assigned and the model weights/configuration were not available.

The focused fixture verifies the concrete backend lifecycle, translator identity, non-empty read-index passthrough, and FP8 DSA pool allocation; it does not claim full-model semantic accuracy or distributed behavior.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
ruff was unavailable in the prepared interpreter and on PATH; py_compile and git diff --check were used for focused static validation.
